description: Shapes props, levels and bodies name by id: a builder of a three.js BufferGeometry with its parameters and a vertex budget.

fields.description: What it is, in plain sentences.
Its parameters as schema fields (engine/core/schema.ts: type, default, description, minimum…), each with a default: what a prop's geometry may set.
The most vertices it may have at its default parameters (the geo QA family checks it).
The builder: (params) => BufferGeometry, standing on the ground, in metres, with normals and UVs in metres (engine/gfx/geometry/).
